title.zh: 卷六 本紀第六 真宗一
title.raw: 卷六 本紀第六 真宗一 Volume 6 Annals 6: Zhenzong 1

sentences.zh: 真宗應符稽古神功讓德文明武定章聖元孝皇帝，諱恆，太宗第三子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhenzong, entitled Responding to the Signs, Examining Antiquity, Divine Merit, Yielding Virtue, Civil and Bright, Martial and Settled, Manifest and Sagely, Primordially Filial, taboo name Heng, was the third son of Emperor Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhenzong—full posthumous style Responding to the Signs through Primordially Filial—whose personal name was Heng, was Taizong's third son.

sentences.zh: 母曰元德皇后李氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Yuande, née Li.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Li, later honored as Empress Yuande.

sentences.zh: 初，乾德五年，五星從鎮星聚奎。

translations.literal: At the beginning, in the fifth year of Qiande, the five planets followed Saturn to gather at Kui.
translations.idiomatic: Legend dated his destiny to Qiande year five, when the five planets trailed Jupiter into a cluster at the Kui asterism.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，后夢以裾承日，有娠，十二月二日生于開封府第，赤光照室，左足指有文成「天」字。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year the empress dreamed that her skirt caught the sun; she became pregnant, and on the second day of the twelfth month gave birth at the Kaifeng commandery residence; red light filled the chamber, and on the left great toe a pattern formed the character "Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: The next spring his mother dreamed the sun rested in her lap; she conceived, and on the second of the twelfth month delivered him at the Kaifeng mansion in a room flooded with red light—on his left great toe the skin bore the character for Heaven.

sentences.zh: 幼英睿，姿表特異，與諸王嬉戲，好作戰陣之狀，自稱元帥。

translations.literal: As a child he was sharp and wise, his bearing extraordinary; when playing with the other princes he liked to arrange battle formations and called himself commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Even as a boy he was quick-witted and striking in appearance; among his brothers he staged mock battles and styled himself supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 太祖愛之，育于宮中。

translations.literal: Taizu favored him and raised him in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu doted on him and kept him in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 嘗登萬歲殿，升御榻坐，太祖大奇之，撫而問曰：「天子好作否？

translations.literal: Once he climbed the Hall of Ten Thousand Years and sat upon the imperial couch; Taizu was greatly astonished, stroked him and asked: "Does it please a Son of Heaven to act thus?
translations.idiomatic: Once he climbed the Hall of Ten Thousand Years and seated himself on the dragon couch; Taizu marveled, caressed him, and asked, "Do you enjoy playing emperor?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「由天命耳。

translations.literal: " He replied: "It depends on Heaven's mandate."
translations.idiomatic: " The boy answered, "Only if Heaven wills it."

sentences.zh: 」比就學受經，一覽成誦。

translations.literal: When he began study and received the classics, he could recite after a single reading.
translations.idiomatic: When tutors set texts before him, he memorized each passage at one hearing.

sentences.zh: 初名德昌，太平興國八年，授檢校太保、同中書門下平章事，封韓王，改名元休。

translations.literal: His original name was Dechang; in the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo he was appointed Acting Grand Guardian and Associate Councilor, enfeoffed as Prince of Han, and renamed Yuanxiu.
translations.idiomatic: He was first named Dechang; in Taiping Xingguo year eight he became acting grand guardian and associate councilor, received the title Prince of Han, and took the name Yuanxiu.

sentences.zh: 端拱元年，封襄王，改元侃。

translations.literal: In the first year of Duan Gong he was enfeoffed Prince of Xiang and renamed Yuankan.
translations.idiomatic: When Duan Gong opened he was made Prince of Xiang and renamed Yuankan.

sentences.zh: 淳化五年九月進封壽王，加檢校太傅、開封尹。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Chunhua he was advanced to Prince of Shou, with the added titles Acting Grand Mentor and metropolitan governor of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua year five, ninth month, he rose to Prince of Shou and picked up acting grand mentor and Kaifeng metropolitan governor.

sentences.zh: 至道元年八月立為皇太子，改今諱，仍判府事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Zhidao he was installed as heir apparent, given his present taboo name, and continued to oversee metropolitan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao year one, eighth month, he was named crown prince, took the name Heng, and still ran the Kaifeng government.

sentences.zh: 故事，殿廬幄次在宰相上，宮僚稱臣，皆推讓弗受。

translations.literal: By precedent the heir's curtain seat in the palace hall ranked above the chief councilors, and palace staff addressed him as "Your subject"; he always declined and would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Custom placed the crown prince's seat above the chief ministers and required palace officers to address him as subject—courtesies he consistently refused.

sentences.zh: 見賓客李至、李沆，必先拜，迎送降階及門。

translations.literal: When he received guests Li Zhi and Li Hang, he always bowed first and escorted them down the steps to the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Before Li Zhi and Li Hang he bowed first and walked them down to the gate.

sentences.zh: 開封政務填委，帝留心獄訟，裁決輕重，靡不稱愜，故京獄屢空，太宗屢詔嘉美。

translations.literal: Kaifeng administration was overwhelming; he attended to lawsuits, weighing severity and leniency so that none went unsatisfied, and the capital prisons were repeatedly emptied, for which Taizong repeatedly issued commendations.
translations.idiomatic: With Kaifeng's docket crushing, he sat in judgment himself, calibrating punishments until litigants left satisfied; the capital jails often stood empty, and Taizong praised him again and again.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，太宗崩，奉遺制即皇帝位于柩前。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year Taizong died; following the testamentary code he took the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year three Taizong died, and he ascended at the bier according to the deathbed instructions.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，尊皇后為皇太后，赦天下，常赦所不原者咸除之。

translations.literal: In summer, on yihai in the fourth month, the empress was honored as empress dowager, the empire was pardoned, and even crimes normally excluded from routine amnesties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the fourth month of summer he raised the empress to empress dowager, declared a general pardon, and extended mercy even to offenses usually barred from clemency.

sentences.zh: 丙申，群臣請聽政，表三上，從之。

translations.literal: On bingchen the hundred officials thrice petitioned that he assume governance, and he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the court submitted three memorials begging him to rule; on the third he agreed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，始見群臣于崇政殿西序，尋賜器幣。

translations.literal: On wuxu he first received the hundred officials in the west wing of Chongzheng Hall and soon bestowed vessels and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he held his first audience in the west annex of Chongzheng Hall and shortly afterward rewarded the assembly with gifts.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，門下侍郎兼兵部尚書、平章事呂端加右僕射；

translations.literal: On guimao Vice Director of the Secretariat concurrent Minister of War and Chief Councilor Lü Duan was promoted Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Lü Duan, vice director of the secretariat, minister of war, and chief councilor, became right vice director of the department of state.

sentences.zh: 弟越王元份進封雍王，吳王元傑進封兗王，並兼中書令；

translations.literal: His younger brother the Prince of Yue Yuan Fen was advanced to Prince of Yong, the Prince of Wu Yuan Jie to Prince of Yan, both concurrently chief councilor;
translations.idiomatic: His brother Yuan Fen, Prince of Yue, was made Prince of Yong, and Yuan Jie, Prince of Wu, Prince of Yan—each concurrently chief councilor as well.

sentences.zh: 徐國公元偓進封彭城郡王，涇國公元偁進封安定郡王，並同平章事；

translations.literal: the Prince of Xu Yuan Wei was advanced to Prince of Pengcheng commandery, the Prince of Jing Yuan Cheng to Prince of Anding commandery, both associate councilor;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Wei of Xu rose to Prince of Pengcheng and Yuan Cheng of Jing to Prince of Anding, both associate councilors;

sentences.zh: 元儼封曹國公。

translations.literal: Yuan Yan was enfeoffed Duke of Cao.
translations.idiomatic: and Yuan Yan received the dukedom of Cao.

sentences.zh: 侄閬州觀察使惟吉為武信軍節度使；

translations.literal: His nephew Langzhou observation commissioner Wei Ji was made military commissioner of Wuxin Army;
translations.idiomatic: Nephew Wei Ji, observation commissioner of Langzhou, was posted as commissioner of Wuxin Army;

sentences.zh: 侍衛馬步軍都虞候傅潛、殿前都指揮使王超、侍衛馬軍都指揮使李繼隆、侍衛步軍都指揮使高瓊並領諸軍節度；

translations.literal: Palace horse-and-foot army deputy commander Fu Qian, Palace Front commander Wang Chao, Palace Cavalry commander Li Jilong, and Palace Infantry commander Gao Qiong each took concurrent circuit commands;
translations.idiomatic: Fu Qian, Wang Chao, Li Jilong, and Gao Qiong—deputy commanders of the palace armies—each picked up a frontier commission;

sentences.zh: 駙馬都尉王承衍、石保吉、魏咸信並為諸軍節度使。

translations.literal: Chief Commandant of Horse Fu Wang Chengyan, Shi Baoji, and Wei Xianxin were all made military commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: and imperial sons-in-law Wang Chengyan, Shi Baoji, and Wei Xianxin became military commissioners in their own right.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宣徽北院使、知樞密院事趙鎔加南院使，左丞李至、禮部侍郎李沆並參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiachen Northern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Directorate and Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhao Yong was given the southern bureau as well; Left Vice Director Li Zhi and Vice Minister of Rites Li Hang were both made participation councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhao Yong of the palace directorate took both northern and southern bureaus of military affairs; Li Zhi and Li Hang joined the council as participation councilors.

sentences.zh: 丁未，中外群臣進秩一等。

translations.literal: On dingwei civil and military officials of court and field alike were promoted one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei every official at court and on the frontier advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 罷鹽鐵、度支、戶部副使。

translations.literal: The deputy commissioners of salt iron, revenue, and census were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He eliminated the three deputy finance commissioners.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，置鎮戎軍。

translations.literal: On guichou Zhenrong Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he founded Zhenrong Army.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，靜海軍節度使、交阯郡王黎桓加兼侍中，進封南平王。

translations.literal: On yimao Jinghai Army military commissioner and King of Jiaozhi Li Huan was given concurrent appointment as palace attendant and advanced to Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Li Huan, commissioner of Jinghai and king of Jiaozhi, became palace attendant and Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，詔求直言。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingmao, an edict called for blunt memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingmao, he invited unsparing criticism.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命兩制議豐盈之術以聞。

translations.literal: On gengwu he ordered drafters of both academies to devise methods for fiscal abundance and report.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he told Hanlin and academy drafters to propose ways to fill the treasury.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，戶部侍郎、參知政事李昌齡責授忠武行軍司馬。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Vice Minister of Revenue and Participation Councilor Li Changling was demoted to acting staff officer of the Zhongwu field army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Changling lost his seat on the council and was banished to the Zhongwu field army.

sentences.zh: 甲申，放宮人給事歲久者。

translations.literal: On jiashen palace women who had served many years were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he freed palace women whose service had run long.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以鎮安軍節度使李繼隆同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingxu Zhen'an Army military commissioner Li Jilong was made associate councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Jilong, commissioner of Zhen'an Army, joined the council.

sentences.zh: 封姊秦國、晉國二公主並為長公主，齊國公主改許國長公主，妹宣慈、賢懿、壽昌、萬壽四公主並為長公主。

translations.literal: His elder sisters the Princesses of Qin and Jin were both made senior princesses; the Princess of Qi was changed to senior princess of Xu; his younger sisters the Princesses of Xuanci, Xianyi, Shouchang, and Wanshou were all made senior princesses.
translations.idiomatic: Sisters of Qin and Jin became senior princesses; Qi was retitled senior princess of Xu; and Xuanci, Xianyi, Shouchang, and Wanshou received the same elevation.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，立秦國夫人郭氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On dinghai Lady Guo of Qin was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he raised Lady Guo of Qin to empress.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，以太宗墨蹟賜天下名山。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yiwei, Taizong's own brushwork was bestowed on famous mountains throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the sixth month he sent Taizong's calligraphy to celebrated peaks empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，追復涪王廷美西京留守兼中書令、秦王，贈兄魏王德昭太傅、岐王德芳太保。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Prince of Fu Tingmei was posthumously restored as Western Capital regent and chief councilor and Prince of Qin; his elder brother Prince of Wei Dezhao was posthumously made Grand Tutor; Prince of Qi Defang was posthumously made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he rehabilitated the executed Prince of Fu Tingmei as Prince of Qin and western capital regent, ennobled Dezhao posthumously as Prince of Wei and grand tutor, and Defang as Prince of Qi and grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上大行皇帝諡曰神功聖德文武皇帝，廟號太宗。

translations.literal: On jihai the late emperor was given the posthumous title Emperor of Divine Merit, Sagely Virtue, Civil and Military Excellence, and the temple name Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he gave his father the posthumous title Emperor of Divine Merit, Sagely Virtue, Civil and Military Excellence, with temple name Taizong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔罷獻祥瑞。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict halted the presentation of auspicious omens.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he forbade officials from reporting lucky prodigies.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，復封兄元佐為楚王。

translations.literal: On jiachen his elder brother Yuan Zuo was again enfeoffed Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he restored Yuan Zuo as Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，追冊莒國夫人潘氏為皇后，諡莊懷。

translations.literal: On yisi Lady Pan of Ju was posthumously installed as empress with the posthumous title Zhuanghuai.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he raised his late consort Lady Pan of Ju to empress Zhuanghuai.

sentences.zh: 以工部侍郎、同知樞密院事錢若水為集賢院學士。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Works and Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Qian Ruoshui was made academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Ruoshui left the military bureau to become an academician of the Hall of Assembled Talents.

sentences.zh: 贈弟元億為代國公。

translations.literal: His younger brother Yuan Yi was posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously ennobled his brother Yuan Yi as Duke of Dai.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，詔轉運使更迭赴闕，訪以民事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on yichou, an edict ordered circuit transport commissioners to rotate to court in succession and be questioned on the people's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the seventh month he summoned transport commissioners to the capital in turn for hearings on local welfare.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔訪孔子嫡孫。

translations.literal: On guiyou an edict sought a direct descendant of Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he ordered a search for Confucius's lineal heir.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以殿前都虞候范廷召領河西軍節度使，葛霸保順軍節度使，王漢忠威塞軍節度使，康保裔彰國軍節度使，王昭遠保靜軍節度使。

translations.literal: On yihai Palace Front deputy commander Fan Tingzhao was given concurrent command of Hexi Army; Ge Ba of Baoshun Army; Wang Hanzhong of Weisai Army; Kang Baoyi of Zhangguo Army; and Wang Zhaoyuan of Baojing Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he posted Fan Tingzhao to Hexi, Ge Ba to Baoshun, Wang Hanzhong to Weisai, Kang Baoyi to Zhangguo, and Wang Zhaoyuan to Baojing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以范廷召、葛霸為定州、鎮州駐泊都部署，王漢忠為高陽關行營都部署，康保裔為并、代州都部署。

translations.literal: On jiashen Fan Tingzhao and Ge Ba were made overall garrison commanders at Ding and Zhen prefectures; Wang Hanzhong was made overall commander of the Gaoyang Pass field army; Kang Baoyi was made overall commander of Bing and Dai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Fan Tingzhao and Ge Ba took supreme command at Dingzhou and Zhenzhou, Wang Hanzhong at Gaoyang Pass, and Kang Baoyi over Bing and Dai.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，罷鹽井役。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingchen, salt-well corvée was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eighth month he ended forced labor at the salt wells.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以鎮海軍節度使曹彬為樞密使，知樞密院事趙鎔為壽州觀察使，同知樞密院事李惟清為御史中丞，戶部侍郎向敏中、給事中夏侯嶠並為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On jihai Zhenhai Army military commissioner Cao Bin was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Director Zhao Yong was made observation commissioner of Shouzhou; Associate Director Li Weiqing was made censor-in-chief; Vice Ministers of Revenue Xiang Minzhong and Secretariat Drafter Xia Houjiao were both made deputy directors of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Cao Bin became director of military affairs while Zhao Yong went to Shouzhou; Li Weiqing became censor-in-chief; Xiang Minzhong and Xia Houjiao joined the military bureau as deputies.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命以十二月二日為承天節。

translations.literal: On gengzi an order made the second day of the twelfth month the festival of Chengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he declared his birthday, the second of the twelfth month, the Chengtian festival.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太白犯太微。

translations.literal: On wushen the Great White Star entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Venus crossed into the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己酉，封乳母齊國夫人劉氏為秦國延壽保聖夫人。

translations.literal: On jiyou wet nurse Lady Liu of Qi was enfeoffed Lady of Qin, Yanhou, Baosheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he ennobled his wet nurse Lady Liu of Qi as Lady of Qin, Yanhou, Baosheng.

sentences.zh: 先是，帝以漢、唐封乳母為夫人、縣君故事付中書，已乃有是命。

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor had submitted to the Secretariat the Han and Tang precedents for enfeoffing wet nurses as ladies and district mistresses; only then came this command.
translations.idiomatic: He had first asked the secretariat to review how Han and Tang courts ennobled wet nurses—then issued the title.

sentences.zh: 戊午，熒惑入東井。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Fire Star entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Mars entered the Eastern Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 庚申，西川廣武卒劉旴逐巡檢使韓景祐，掠蜀、漢等州，招安使上官正、鈐轄馬知節討平之。

translations.literal: On gengshen Guangwu troops of western Sichuan under Liu Xu drove out inspection commissioner Han Jingyou and plundered Shu, Han, and other prefectures; pacification commissioner Shangguan Zheng and controller Ma Zhijie suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Liu Xu's mutineers expelled Han Jingyou and ravaged western Sichuan until Shangguan Zheng and Ma Zhijie crushed the revolt.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，二星隕西南。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingchou, two stars fell in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the ninth month two meteors streaked southwest.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以孔子四十五世孫延世為曲阜縣令，襲封文宣公。

translations.literal: On wuyin Confucius's forty-fifth-generation descendant Yanshi was made magistrate of Qufu and inherited the title Duke of Literary Propagation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he installed Confucius's forty-fifth-generation heir Yanshi as magistrate of Qufu and Duke of Literary Propagation.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，夏人寇靈州，合河都部署楊瓊擊走之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Xia troops raided Lingzhou; Hehe overall deployment commissioner Yang Qiong drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Tangut raiders struck Lingzhou and Yang Qiong of Hehe beat them back.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬太宗于永熙陵。

translations.literal: On jiyou Taizong was buried at Yongxi Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Taizong was laid to rest at Yongxi Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜山陵使而下銀帛有差。

translations.literal: On dingsi the tomb commissioner and his staff were given silver and silks in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he rewarded the burial commissioners with graded gifts of silver and silk.

sentences.zh: 歲星入氐。

translations.literal: The Year Star entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter entered the Di asterism.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，祔太宗神主于太廟，以懿德皇后配，祔莊懷皇后于別廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, Taizong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple with Empress Yide as consort; Empress Zhuanghuai was enshrined in a separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eleventh month Taizong entered the ancestral temple beside Empress Yide, while Empress Zhuanghuai received a side shrine.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔兩京死罪以下遞減一等，緣山陵役民賜租有差。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict reduced capital crimes in the two capitals by one degree, and corvée laborers on the mausoleum were granted graded rent remissions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he commuted capital sentences in both capitals one step and cut rent for peasants conscripted on the tomb works.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔工部侍郎錢若水修太宗實錄。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict ordered Vice Minister of Works Qian Ruoshui to compile Taizong's Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he put Qian Ruoshui in charge of Taizong's Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜帛西鄙餫餉士卒。

translations.literal: On jimao silks were bestowed to supply frontier troops in the west.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he sent cloth to feed soldiers on the western marches.

sentences.zh: 閱騎射，擢精銳者十人遷職。

translations.literal: Mounted archery was reviewed, and ten picked men were promoted.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected cavalry archery and promoted ten standouts.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，廢理檢院。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Court of Petitions and Appeals was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he abolished the Court of Petitions and Appeals.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，承天節，群臣上壽於崇德殿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guisi, the Chengtian festival, the hundred officials offered longevity wishes at Chongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, his birthday, the court wished him long life at Chongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙申，追尊母賢妃李氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: On bingchen his mother Consort Li was posthumously honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he raised his late mother Consort Li to empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔諸路轉運使申飭令長劭農。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict ordered circuit transport commissioners to admonish magistrates to encourage agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he told every transport commissioner to press local officials on farming.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以銀州觀察使趙保吉為定難軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jiachen Yinzhou observation commissioner Zhao Baoji was made military commissioner of Dingnan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhao Baoji of Yinzhou became commissioner of Dingnan Army.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年春正月辛酉，詔改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Xianping, on xinyou, an edict changed the reign title.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the first month of Xianping year one he proclaimed a new reign.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上皇太后李氏諡曰元德。

translations.literal: On bingyin Empress Dowager Li was given the posthumous title Yuande.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he gave his mother the posthumous title Yuande.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，召學官崔頤正講書，因命宰臣選明經術者以聞。

translations.literal: On dingchou academician Cui Yizheng was summoned to lecture on the classics, and chief councilors were ordered to nominate men versed in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he heard Cui Yizheng lecture and told his councilors to recommend scholars of classical learning.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，閱御龍直。

translations.literal: On wuyin the Imperial Dragon Straight corps was reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he inspected the Imperial Dragon guard.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，僧你尾尼等自西天來朝，稱七年始達。

translations.literal: On xinsi the monk Niweini and others came to court from India, saying seven years had passed since they set out.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Indian monk Niweini and his party reached court after a seven-year journey.

sentences.zh: 甲申，彗出營室北。

translations.literal: On jiashen a comet appeared north of the Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen a comet rose north of the Encampment asterism.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，呂端等言彗出之應，當在齊、魯分。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guisi, Lü Duan and others said the comet's omen would fall in the Qi and Lu regions.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the second month Lü Duan argued the comet threatened Qi and Lu.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕以天下為憂，豈直一方耶？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I take the whole realm as my worry—how can it be only one region?"
translations.idiomatic: "The whole empire troubles me," he replied; "why blame a single circuit?"

sentences.zh: 」甲午，詔求直言，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict called for blunt memorials, avoidance of the main hall, and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he invited criticism, moved out of the main hall, and cut his table.

sentences.zh: 乙未，慮囚，老幼疾病，流以下聽贖，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: On yiwei prisoners were reviewed; the aged, young, and sick among exiles and below were permitted to redeem penalties, and those at beating and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he reviewed the prisons, allowed the old and infirm to buy out exile, and freed everyone below beating.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，彗滅。

translations.literal: On dingyou the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the comet disappeared.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，置太平州。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jisi, Taiping prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the third month he created Taiping prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜進士孫僅等宴瓊林。

translations.literal: On renshen the jinshi graduates led by Sun Jin were feasted at Qionglin.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he banqueted Sun Jin and the new jinshi at Qionglin Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以趙保吉歸順，遣使諭陝西，縱綏、銀流民還鄉，家給米一斛。

translations.literal: On xinsi because Zhao Baoji had submitted, envoys were sent to instruct Shaanxi to let refugees of Sui and Yin circuits return home, each household receiving one hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, with Zhao Baoji's surrender secured, he ordered Shaanxi to send Sui and Yin refugees home with a hu of grain per household.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，旱。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: Summer brought drought.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禱白鹿山。

translations.literal: On renchen prayers were offered at Bailu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he prayed for rain at Bailu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，趙保吉遣弟繼瑗入謝。

translations.literal: On renyin Zhao Baoji sent his younger brother Jiyuan to court to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhao Baoji's brother Jiyuan arrived to offer thanks.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣使按天下吏民逋負，悉除之。

translations.literal: On jiyou envoys were dispatched to audit arrears owed by officials and commoners throughout the realm, and all were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou commissioners canceled every public and private debt in the empire.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuwu, the new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon in the fifth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸大相國寺祈雨，升殿而雨。

translations.literal: On jiazi he visited the Great Xiangguo Monastery to pray for rain; when he ascended the hall, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi rain came the moment he entered Great Xiangguo Monastery to pray.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，詔近臣舉常參官才堪轉運使者。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinmao, an edict ordered close ministers to recommend regular officials fit for transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the sixth month he asked his inner circle to name men worthy of circuit transport.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以旱，免開封、二十五州軍田租。

translations.literal: On bingchen, because of drought, land tax was remitted in Kaifeng and twenty-five prefectures and armies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen drought relief canceled the harvest tax in Kaifeng and twenty-five circuits.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，詔民供億山陵者賜租什二。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiazi, an edict granted those who had supplied the mausoleum works a twenty-percent rent remission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the seventh month he cut rent twenty percent for families that had fed the tomb labor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔沿淮諸州藏瘞遺骸。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict ordered prefectures along the Huai to collect and bury exposed corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he told Huai River prefectures to gather and bury the unburied dead.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，禁新小錢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guimao, new small coin was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the eighth month he banned debased small cash.

sentences.zh: 己酉，幸諸王宮。

translations.literal: On jiyou he visited the princes' palaces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he made the rounds of his brothers' mansions.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，詔呂端、錢若水重修太祖實錄。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi, an edict ordered Lü Duan and Qian Ruoshui to revise Taizu's Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the ninth month he set Lü Duan and Qian Ruoshui to revise Taizu's Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜終南隱士种放粟帛緡錢。

translations.literal: On renshen the Zhongnan recluse Zhong Fang was given grain, silks, and cash.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he rewarded the hermit Zhong Fang of Zhongnan with grain, cloth, and money.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以左衛上將軍張永德為太子太師。

translations.literal: On jimao Left Guard general-in-chief Zhang Yongde was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Zhang Yongde, left guard general, became grand preceptor of the heir.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on bingxu, the new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon in the tenth month of winter the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，呂端為太子太保，戶部尚書張齊賢、參知政事李沆並平章事，李至為武勝軍節度使。

translations.literal: On wuzi Lü Duan became Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Minister of Revenue Zhang Qixian and Participation Councilor Li Hang were both made chief councilors; Li Zhi was made military commissioner of Wusheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Lü Duan moved to grand guardian of the heir, Zhang Qixian and Li Hang joined the chief council, and Li Zhi took Wusheng Army.

sentences.zh: 己丑，參知政事溫仲舒罷為禮部尚書，樞密副使夏侯嶠罷為戶部侍郎、翰林侍讀學士，以樞密副使向敏中為兵部侍郎、參知政事，翰林學士楊礪、宋湜並為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On jichou Participation Councilor Wen Zhongshu was dismissed to Minister of Rites; Deputy Director of Military Affairs Xia Houjiao was dismissed to Vice Minister of Revenue and Hanlin Attendant Reader; Deputy Director Xiang Minzhong became Vice Minister of War and participation councilor; Hanlin Academicians Yang Li and Song Wen were both made deputy directors of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wen Zhongshu left the council for the ministry of rites, Xia Houjiao for revenue and a reader's post, while Xiang Minzhong entered the council and Yang Li and Song Wen joined the military bureau.

sentences.zh: 丙午，許群臣著述詣閤獻，令兩制銓簡。

translations.literal: On bingwu the hundred officials were permitted to present writings at the palace gate for the two academies to screen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he invited officials to submit books for Hanlin review at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，龍缽貢馬二千騎。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, the Longpan tribe presented two thousand horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eleventh month the Longpan people sent two thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔葺歷代帝王陵廟。

translations.literal: On jiazi an edict ordered the mausoleums of emperors of past dynasties to be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he commanded restoration of ancient imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，幸許國長公主第視疾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, he visited the senior princess of Xu's residence to inquire after her illness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the twelfth month he called on the senior princess of Xu, who lay ill.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，令三司判官舉才堪知州者各一人。

translations.literal: On guimao he ordered each fiscal commissioner of the three departments to recommend one man fit to govern a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao every fiscal commissioner had to name one candidate for prefect.

sentences.zh: 是歲，溪峒、吐蕃諸族、勒浪十六府大首領、甘州回鶻、西南蕃黎州山後蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year the stream-dong tribes, various Tibetan clans, the sixteen prefectures of the Lelang, Ganzhou Uighurs, and the post-mountain Yi of Lizhou in the southwest presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year stream-dong chiefs, Tibetan groups, Lelang lords, Ganzhou Uighurs, and southwestern Yi all sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 定州雹傷稼，遣使振恤，除是年租。

translations.literal: Hail at Dingzhou damaged the crops; envoys were sent to relieve and comfort, and that year's rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Hail ruined Dingzhou's harvest, so he sent relief and canceled the year's tax.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲子，詔：尚書丞、郎、給、舍，舉升朝官可守大郡者各一人。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on jiazi, an edict ordered vice ministers, directors, drafters, and remonstrance officials each to nominate one court official fit to govern a large prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the second year he told every central official to name one man capable of running a major prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙子，定諸司使以下至三班使臣有罪比品聽贖。

translations.literal: On bingzi regulations were set for commissioners and below through third-rank envoys to redeem offenses according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he codified rank-based redemption for fiscal commissioners and third-rank envoys.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，以趙普配饗太祖廟庭。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingchen, Zhao Pu was given a place in Taizu's temple entourage.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the second month Zhao Pu joined Taizu's temple entourage.

sentences.zh: 詔群臣迎養父母，蠲天下逋負，釋繫囚。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the hundred officials to bring parents to live with them, remitted arrears throughout the realm, and released prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: He urged officials to house their parents, canceled empire-wide debts, and opened the prisons.

sentences.zh: 己酉，戒百官比周奔競，有弗率者，御史臺糾之。

translations.literal: On jiyou he admonished the hundred officials against weekly scrambling for favor; those who would not reform were to be impeached by the censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he warned the bureaucracy against weekly court faction fights and told the censorate to indict the unreformed.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，江、浙發廩振饑。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingchen, Jiang and Zhe circuits opened granaries to relieve famine.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the third month Jiangnan and Zhe opened state granaries.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，置荊湖南路轉運使。

translations.literal: On wuchen the Jinghu South circuit transport commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he created the Jinghu South transport commission.

sentences.zh: 壬申，王漢忠為涇、原、邠、寧、靈、環都部署。

translations.literal: On renshen Wang Hanzhong was made overall deployment commissioner of Jing, Yuan, Bin, Ning, Ling, and Huan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wang Hanzhong took supreme command over the northwestern six circuits.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁亥，以久不雨，帝諭宰相曰：「凡政有闕失，宜相規以道，毋惜直言。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on dinghai, because rain had long failed, the emperor told the chief councilors: "Wherever policy falls short, you should correct me by the Way; do not spare blunt words."
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the intercalary month, with drought lingering, he told his councilors, "Correct my mistakes openly—do not flatter."

sentences.zh: 」詔天下繫囚非十惡、枉法及已殺人者，死以下減一等。

translations.literal: An edict reduced by one degree all prisoners empire-wide who were not guilty of the ten abominations, corruption, or completed murder.
translations.idiomatic: He commuted every capital sentence short of the ten abominations, graft, or murder.

sentences.zh: 幸許國長公主第視疾，又幸北宅視德愿疾。

translations.literal: He visited the senior princess of Xu's residence to inquire after her illness, and also visited the Northern Residence to inquire after Deyuan's illness.
translations.idiomatic: He called again on the princess of Xu and on his cousin Deyuan at the Northern Residence.

sentences.zh: 詔兩京諸路收瘞暴骸，營塞破塚。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the two capitals and all circuits to collect and bury exposed corpses and repair ruined tombs.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered every circuit to bury the dead in the open and restore broken graves.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸太一宮、天清寺祈雨。

translations.literal: On wuzi he visited the Great One Palace and Tianqing Monastery to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he prayed for rain at the Great One Palace and Tianqing Monastery.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上皇太后宮名曰萬安。

translations.literal: On jichou the empress dowager's palace was named Wan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he named the empress dowager's residence Wan'an.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，罷有司營繕之不急者。

translations.literal: On gengyin non-urgent government construction was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he stopped nonessential public works.

sentences.zh: 詔中外臣直言極諫。

translations.literal: An edict invited blunt counsel from officials at court and in the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: He called on every official, capital or provincial, to speak without fear.

sentences.zh: 從弟德愿卒。

translations.literal: His younger cousin Deyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: His cousin Deyuan died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，雨。

translations.literal: On renchen it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen rain finally fell.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，江南轉運使言宣、歙竹生米，民採食之。

translations.literal: On xinchou the Jiangnan transport commissioner reported that in Xuan and She prefectures bamboo bore grain and the people gathered it to eat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Jiangnan reported Xuan and She bamboo sprouting edible seeds that starving peasants harvested.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔江、浙饑民入城池漁採勿禁。

translations.literal: On bingwu an edict permitted hungry people of Jiang and Zhe to enter cities and gather fish and wild foods without prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he let Jiang-Zhe famine refugees forage in cities and waterways.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，許國長公主薨。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingyin, the senior princess of Xu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the fourth month of summer the senior princess of Xu died.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，嚴服用之制。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dinghai, mourning dress regulations were tightened.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the fifth month he tightened the code of mourning garb.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸曹彬第視疾。

translations.literal: On yisi he visited Cao Bin's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he called on the ailing Cao Bin.

sentences.zh: 七月甲申，以傅潛為鎮、定、高陽關行營都部署，張昭允為都鈐轄。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jiashen, Fu Qian was made overall commander of the Zhen, Ding, and Gaoyang Pass field army; Zhang Zhaoyun was made overall controller.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the seventh month Fu Qian took field command on the Hebei front with Zhang Zhaoyun as controller.

sentences.zh: 給外任官職田。

translations.literal: Official farmland was granted to officials serving outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He assigned tax-exempt fields to officials posted outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以橫海軍節度使王顯為樞密使。

translations.literal: On jichou Henghai Army military commissioner Wang Xian was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Xian of Henghai Army became director of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制聖教序賜傳法院。

translations.literal: On renyin the imperial preface to the sutras was bestowed on the Transmission of the Dharma Court.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he presented his sutra preface to the Transmission of the Dharma Court.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸國子監，召學官崔偓佺講尚書 大禹謨。

translations.literal: On jiachen he visited the Directorate of Education and summoned academician Cui Weiquan to lecture on the "Counsels of Yu the Great" in the Documents.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he went to the Directorate of Education and heard Cui Weiquan lecture on Yu's counsels from the Documents.

sentences.zh: 還幸崇文院，賜秘書監、祭酒以下器幣。

translations.literal: Returning, he visited Chongwen Hall and bestowed vessels and silks on the director of the palace library, libationer, and those below.
translations.idiomatic: He stopped at Chongwen Hall afterward and rewarded the library staff.

sentences.zh: 丙午，置翰林侍讀學士，以兵部侍郎楊徽之等為之；

translations.literal: On bingwu Hanlin Attendant Reader was established, with Vice Minister of War Yang Huizhi and others appointed;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he created the post of Hanlin attendant reader and named Yang Huizhi and others;

sentences.zh: 置翰林侍講學士，以國子祭酒邢昺為之。

translations.literal: Hanlin Attendant Lecturer was established, with National University libationer Xing Bing appointed.
translations.idiomatic: and attendant lecturer, with Xing Bing of the National University as first holder.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，御文德殿，文武百官入閤。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinhai, he held court at Wende Hall and the civil and military hundred officials entered the inner gate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the eighth month he received the full bureaucracy at Wende Hall in grand audience.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，群臣上尊號曰崇文廣武聖明仁孝皇帝。

translations.literal: On yimao the hundred officials offered the honorific Civil and Exalted, Martial and Sagely, Bright and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the court offered him the title Civil and Exalted, Martial and Sagely, Bright and Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大宴崇德殿，始作樂。

translations.literal: On dingsi a great banquet was held at Chongde Hall and music was performed for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he feasted at Chongde Hall and heard court music for the first time since mourning.

sentences.zh: 戊午，社宴近臣于中書。

translations.literal: On wuwu the chief councilors were feasted at the Altar of Soil.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he hosted his councilors at the autumn soil rite.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大閱於東北郊。

translations.literal: On bingyin a grand review was held in the northeastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he held a grand military review outside the northeast gate.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，楊礪卒。

translations.literal: On guiyou Yang Li died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Yang Li died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以太師贈濟陽郡王曹彬配饗太祖廟庭，司空贈太尉中書令薛居正、忠武軍節度使贈中書令潘美、右僕射贈侍中石熙載配饗太宗廟庭。

translations.literal: On yihai Grand Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Jiyang commandery Cao Bin was given a place in Taizu's temple entourage; Grand Marshal posthumously enfeoffed Grand Preceptor and Chief Councilor Xue Juzheng, Zhongwu Army military commissioner posthumously enfeoffed Chief Councilor Pan Mei, and Right Vice Director posthumously enfeoffed Palace Attendant Shi Xizai were given places in Taizong's temple entourage.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Cao Bin joined Taizu's temple entourage, while Xue Juzheng, Pan Mei, and Shi Xizai were enshrined with Taizong.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengchen, the new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon in the ninth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，召宗室宴射後苑。

translations.literal: On wuzi the imperial clan was summoned to feast and shoot in the rear park.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he banqueted the princes for archery in the rear garden.

sentences.zh: 甲午，奉安太宗聖容於啟聖院新殿，帝拜而慟，左右皆掩泣。

translations.literal: On jiawu Taizong's sacred image was installed in the new hall of Qisheng Monastery; the emperor bowed and wept, and those beside him covered their faces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Taizong's portrait entered Qisheng Monastery's new hall; the emperor bowed in tears while attendants wept.

sentences.zh: 賜修殿內侍緡錢。

translations.literal: Palace eunuchs who had repaired the hall were given cash.
translations.idiomatic: He rewarded the eunuchs who had built the hall.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，幸騏驥院，賜從官馬，還宴射後苑。

translations.literal: On guimao he visited the Imperial Horse Stud, bestowed horses on attending officials, returned, and feasted and shot in the rear park.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he toured the stud, gave horses to his train, and held another archery feast in the rear garden.

sentences.zh: 鎮、定都部署言敗契丹兵於廉良路，殺獲甚眾。

translations.literal: The Zhen and Ding overall deployment commissioner reported defeating Khitan troops on the Lianliang road with many killed and captured.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei headquarters reported a victory on the Lianliang road with heavy Khitan losses.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，宜州執溪峒蠻酋三十餘人詣闕，詔釋其罪，遣還。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renzi, Yizhou seized more than thirty stream-dong chieftains and sent them to court; an edict released their crimes and sent them home.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the tenth month Yizhou sent up thirty stream-dong chiefs; he pardoned them and sent them back.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，放澧州蠻界歸業民租。

translations.literal: On guichou rent was remitted for people returning to settle within the Lian prefecture tribal border.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he canceled rent for families resettling along the Lian tribal frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊午，置福建路惠民倉。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Fujian circuit People's Relief Granary was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he founded a relief granary for Fujian circuit.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，詔親王領大都督府節鎮者勿兼長史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renwu, an edict ordered imperial princes who held great capital governorships and circuit commands not to hold the post of chief magistrate concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the eleventh month he barred imperial princes with grand commissions from also serving as prefectural chief magistrate.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，饗太廟。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Imperial Ancestral Temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he offered the autumn ancestral feast.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，祀天地于圜丘，以太祖、太宗配，大赦天下，錄功臣子孫之無祿者。

translations.literal: On bingxu Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the Circular Mound with Taizu and Taizong as partners; the empire was greatly pardoned, and descendants of meritorious officials without stipends were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the round altar with Taizu and Taizong, declared a great amnesty, and enrolled stipendless heirs of founding ministers.

sentences.zh: 御朝元殿受尊號冊。

translations.literal: At Chaoyuan Hall he received the honorific register.
translations.idiomatic: At Chaoyuan Hall he accepted the new honorific scroll.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賜群臣帶服、鞍馬、器幣有差。

translations.literal: On dinghai the hundred officials were given belts, robes, saddles, horses, vessels, and silks in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he rewarded the court with graded belts, mounts, and gifts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大宴含光殿。

translations.literal: On gengyin a great banquet was held at Hanguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he feasted at Hanguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，張齊賢加門下侍郎，李沆加中書侍郎，中外臣悉加恩。

translations.literal: On renchen Zhang Qixian was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Li Hang was made Vice Director of the Chancellery; civil and military officials alike received grace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zhang Qixian became vice director of the secretariat and Li Hang of the chancellery, and the whole bureaucracy was promoted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以左神武軍大將軍德恭為左衛大將軍，左衛大將軍德彝為左神武軍大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiawu Left Divine Martial Army general-in-chief Degong was made Left Guard general-in-chief, and Left Guard general-in-chief Deyi was made Left Divine Martial Army general-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he swapped the commands of princes Degong and Deyi between the divine martial and guard armies.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔：幸河北，所次頓舍給用，毋泛及州縣。

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict ordered: when traveling to Hebei, supplies at halting places were to be provided without broadly burdening prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he decreed that his Hebei march be supplied at camp stops without levying whole prefectures.

sentences.zh: 以周瑩為駕前軍都部署，石保吉為行營先鋒都部署。

translations.literal: Zhou Ying was made overall commander of the army before the imperial carriage; Shi Baoji was made overall vanguard commander of the field army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Ying commanded the imperial escort and Shi Baoji the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 己亥，狩近郊。

translations.literal: On jihai he hunted near the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he hunted outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賜京城父老衣帛。

translations.literal: On xinchou the elders of the capital were given cloth and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he gave cloth and silk to Kaifeng's elders.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以魏咸信為貝冀行營都部署。

translations.literal: On wushen Wei Xianxin was made overall deployment commissioner of the Bei-Ji field army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Wei Xianxin took supreme command on the Bei-Ji front.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以李沆為東京留守。

translations.literal: On jiyou Li Hang was made Eastern Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Hang stayed behind as eastern capital regent.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，賜近臣戎服廄馬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinhai, close ministers were given military garb and stud horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the twelfth month he armed his inner circle and gave them stud horses.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，駕發京師，次陳橋。

translations.literal: On jiayin the imperial carriage departed the capital and halted at Chen Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he left Kaifeng and camped at Chen Bridge.

sentences.zh: 王昭遠卒。

translations.literal: Wang Zhaoyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhaoyuan died on the march.

sentences.zh: 戊午，駐蹕澶州。

translations.literal: On wuwu the emperor halted at Chanzou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he made camp at Chanzou.

sentences.zh: 冀州言敗契丹兵於城南，殺千餘人，奪馬百餘匹。

translations.literal: Jizhou reported defeating Khitan troops south of the city, killing more than a thousand and seizing more than a hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou reported a southern victory with a thousand Khitan dead and a hundred horses taken.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，宴從臣于行宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou attending ministers were feasted at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he banqueted his councilors at the field palace.

sentences.zh: 以王超等督先鋒，仍示以陣圖，俾識部分。

translations.literal: Wang Chao and others were ordered to direct the vanguard and were shown battle diagrams so they would know their sections.
translations.idiomatic: He put Wang Chao in charge of the van and issued battle maps so each unit knew its place.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賜近臣甲胄弓劍。

translations.literal: On renxu close ministers were given armor, bows, and swords.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he issued armor and weapons to his inner circle.

sentences.zh: 幸浮橋，登臨河亭，賜澶州父老錦袍、茶帛。

translations.literal: He visited the floating bridge, ascended the Linhe Pavilion, and bestowed brocade robes, tea, and silks on the elders of Chanzou.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the floating bridge, climbed Linhe Pavilion, and rewarded Chanzou's elders with robes, tea, and silk.

sentences.zh: 甲子，次大名，躬御鎧甲於中軍。

translations.literal: On jiazi he halted at Daming and personally donned armor in the central army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he reached Daming and buckled on armor at headquarters.

sentences.zh: 契丹攻威虜軍，本軍擊敗之，殺其酋帥。

translations.literal: The Khitan attacked Weilu Army; the garrison defeated them and killed their commander.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan assault on Weilu Army failed when the garrison killed their leader.

sentences.zh: 府州言官軍入契丹五合川，拔黃太尉砦，殲其眾，焚其車帳，獲馬牛萬計。

translations.literal: Fuzhou reported that government troops entered the Khitan Wuhechuan, took Yellow Grand Preceptor's stockade, destroyed the enemy host, burned their carts and tents, and captured tens of thousands of cattle and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou reported a raid into Wuhechuan that stormed Yellow Grand Preceptor's fort, burned the camp, and seized vast herds.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召見大名府父老，勞賜之。

translations.literal: On dingmao the elders of Daming prefecture were summoned, comforted, and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he received Daming's elders, thanked them, and gave gifts.

sentences.zh: 是歲，沙州蕃族首領、邛部川蠻、西南蕃、占城、大食國來貢。

translations.literal: That year the chieftains of Shazhou tribes, the Qiong tribal Yi, southwestern tribes, Champa, and the Dashi state presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shazhou tribes, Qiong Yi, southwestern peoples, Champa, and Dashi Arabia all sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 江、浙、廣南、荊湖旱，嵐州春霜害稼，分使發粟振之。

translations.literal: Drought struck Jiang, Zhe, Guangnan, Jinghu, and Huguang; spring frost in Lanzhou damaged crops; commissioners were sent in separate directions to open grain stores for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Drought ravaged the southeast while Lanzhou lost its crop to frost; he dispatched relief commissioners in every direction.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己卯朔，駐蹕大名府。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on jimao, the new-moon day, he halted at Daming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon in the third year's spring he was still encamped at Daming.

sentences.zh: 詔并代都部署高瓊等分屯冀州、邢州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Bing and Dai overall deployment commissioner Gao Qiong and others to divide forces and garrison at Jizhou and Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He told Gao Qiong and the Bing-Dai command to split troops between Jizhou and Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，臨視樞密副使宋湜疾。

translations.literal: On xinsi he went in person to visit Deputy Director of Military Affairs Song Wen, who was ill.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he visited the sick deputy director Song Wen.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以葛霸為貝冀、高陽關前軍行營都部署。

translations.literal: On guimao Ge Ba was made overall commander of the Bei-Ji and Gaoyang Pass vanguard field army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Ge Ba took the vanguard command on the Bei-Ji and Gaoyang front.

sentences.zh: 萊州防禦使田紹斌凡十人以功進秩。

translations.literal: Laizhou defense commissioner Tian Shaobin and nine others were promoted in rank for merit.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Shaobin of Laizhou and nine other officers were promoted for service.

sentences.zh: 契丹犯河間，高陽關都部署康保裔死之。

translations.literal: The Khitan invaded Hejian; Gaoyang Pass overall deployment commissioner Kang Baoyi died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan forces took Hejian and killed Kang Baoyi at Gaoyang Pass.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，流忠武軍節度使傅潛于房州、都鈐轄張昭允于通州，並削奪官爵。

translations.literal: On yiyou Zhongwu Army military commissioner Fu Qian was exiled to Fangzhou and overall controller Zhang Zhaoyun to Tongzhou; both were stripped of office and titles.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he stripped Fu Qian of rank and exiled him to Fangzhou, and Zhang Zhaoyun to Tongzhou—for abandoning the front.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸紫極宮，還登子城閱騎射。

translations.literal: On dinghai he visited the Purple Ultimate Palace, then returned and ascended the inner wall to review mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he worshiped at the Purple Ultimate Palace and inspected cavalry archery from the inner rampart.

sentences.zh: 高陽關、貝冀路都部署范廷召等追契丹至莫州，斬首萬餘級。

translations.literal: Gaoyang Pass and Bei-Ji overall deployment commissioner Fan Tingzhao and others pursued the Khitan to Mozhou and beheaded more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Tingzhao and the Hebei command chased the Khitan to Mozhou and took ten thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，赦河北及淄、齊州罪人，非持杖劫盜、謀故殺、枉法贓、十惡至死者並釋之。

translations.literal: On gengyin Hebei and Zi and Qi prefectures were pardoned; except for armed robbery, plotted murder, corruption, the ten abominations, and those already sentenced to death, all were released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he declared amnesty in Hebei, Zi, and Qi—freeing every prisoner short of capital crimes, armed robbery, murder plots, graft, or the ten abominations.

sentences.zh: 錄將吏死事者子孫，民被焚掠者復其租。

translations.literal: Recorded the descendants of officers and clerks who died in service; for commoners who suffered burning and plundering, their rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He enrolled the orphans of officers killed in the campaign and canceled back rent for civilians plundered by the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 罷緣邊二十三州軍榷酤。

translations.literal: Abolished the liquor monopoly in twenty-three frontier prefectures and commands.
translations.idiomatic: He ended the salt-and-wine monopoly across twenty-three frontier circuits.

sentences.zh: 令諸州舉吏民有武藝及材力過人者。

translations.literal: Ordered each prefecture to recommend commoners and clerks with martial skill or exceptional strength and talent.
translations.idiomatic: He told every prefecture to nominate civilians and clerks with proven fighting skill or unusual ability.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宋湜卒。

translations.literal: On renchen, Song Min died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Song Min, the ailing deputy military affairs commissioner, died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，發大名府。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he departed from Daming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the court broke camp and left Daming.

sentences.zh: 益州軍變，害鈐轄符昭壽，逐知州牛冕等，推都虞候王均為首作亂。

translations.literal: Yizhou troops mutinied, killed controller Fu Zhaoshou, drove out Prefect Niu Mian and others, and made company commander Wang Jun their leader in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The Yizhou garrison rose, murdered controller Fu Zhaoshou, expelled Prefect Niu Mian, and proclaimed company commander Wang Jun their chief.

sentences.zh: 詔戶部使雷有終為廬州觀察使，帥師會李惠等討之，均閉城門固守。

translations.literal: An edict named Revenue Minister Lei Youzhong Luzhou observation commissioner and ordered him to join Li Hui and others in attacking them; Jun shut the gates and held firm.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong sent Revenue Minister Lei Youzhong to command Luzhou troops against the rebels, but Wang Jun barred the walls and refused battle.

sentences.zh: 庚子，至自大名府。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he returned from Daming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he re-entered the capital from Daming.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸呂端第視疾。

translations.literal: On wushen, he visited Lü Duan's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he called at Chief Councilor Lü Duan's sickroom.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，宴含光殿。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengshen, he feasted at Hanguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the second month he held court at Hanguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔：「近臣并知雜御史、尚書省五品及帶館閣三司職者，各舉升朝官有武幹堪邊任一人。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict stated: "Close ministers together with supervising miscellaneous censors, Secretariat officials of the fifth rank, and those holding Academy, Directorate, or Three Departments concurrent posts shall each recommend one court official of promotion rank with martial capacity fit for frontier duty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he ordered close advisers, supervising censors, fifth-rank Secretariat officers, and officials with Academy or fiscal concurrent posts each to name one promoted official with frontier fighting experience.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以周瑩為宣徽南院使，王繼英為北院使，並知樞密院事；

translations.literal: " On guihai, Zhou Ying was made south-court palace proclamation commissioner and Wang Jiying north-court commissioner, both with concurrent authority over the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he named Zhou Ying south-court envoy and Wang Jiying north-court envoy, both supervising military affairs;

sentences.zh: 王旦為給事中，同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Wang Dan was made drafting recipient and associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: and made Wang Dan drafting recipient and associate military affairs director.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以王顯為定州路行營都部署，王超為鎮州路行營都部署。

translations.literal: On yichou, Wang Xian was made overall commander of the Dingzhou route field army; Wang Chao was made overall commander of the Zhenzhou route field army.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Wang Xian took the Dingzhou expedition and Wang Chao the Zhenzhou line against the Sichuan rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，益州王均開城偽遁，雷有終等入城為所敗，退保漢州，李惠死之。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Wang Jun of Yizhou opened the gates in a feigned retreat; Lei Youzhong and others entered the city and were defeated, withdrew to defend Hanzhou, and Li Hui died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wang Jun feigned flight, then smashed Lei Youzhong inside the walls; the government force fell back to Hanzhou and Li Hui was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，京畿旱，慮囚。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the capital region suffered drought; prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen drought gripped the capital circuits and he held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大雨。

translations.literal: On guiyou, heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the long drought broke in torrents.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，置靜樂軍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Jingle Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he created Jingle Army command.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賞花苑中，召從臣宴射。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he viewed flowers in the garden and summoned attending ministers to feast and shoot.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he toured the flower gardens and called his ministers to an archery banquet.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuyin, the new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon in the third month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，御崇政殿試禮部貢舉人。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he presided at Chongzheng Hall over the Ministry of Rites examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he personally examined the civil graduates at Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，詔天下死罪減一等，流以下釋之，十惡至死、謀故劫殺、坐贓枉法者論如律。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingmao, an edict ordered that capital crimes throughout the empire be reduced one degree, exile and lesser punishments released, while the ten abominations through death, plotted or bandit murder, and corruption by law were punished according to statute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the fifth month he commuted most death sentences empire-wide and freed everyone below exile, reserving full punishment only for the ten abominations, plotted murder, armed robbery, and corrupt judges.

sentences.zh: 幸玉津園觀刈麥。

translations.literal: He visited Yujin Garden to view the wheat harvest.
translations.idiomatic: He rode to Yujin Garden to inspect the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸金明池觀水嬉，遂幸瓊林苑宴射。

translations.literal: On jichou, he visited Jinming Pool to watch water games, then visited Qionlin Garden for feasting and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he watched boat races at Jinming Pool, then moved the court to Qionlin Garden for feast and archery.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，御試河北舉人。

translations.literal: On renyin, he personally examined Hebei examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he held the special Hebei civil examination in person.

sentences.zh: 河決鄆州，詔徙州城。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Yan prefecture; an edict ordered the prefectural seat moved.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River broke at Yanzhou he ordered the city relocated to higher ground.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei, the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiwei, Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以向敏中為河北、河東宣撫使，按巡郡國，存慰士民。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Xiang Minzhong was made Hebei and Hedong pacification commissioner to inspect the circuits, preserve order, and comfort soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he sent Xiang Minzhong through Hebei and Hedong as pacification commissioner to audit local government and reassure the war-weary populace.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，以翰林侍讀學士夏侯嶠、侍講邢昺為江、浙巡撫使。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jihai, Hanlin Academician Reader Xiahou Qiao and Academician Lecturer Xing Bing were made Jiang and Zhe inspection commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the seventh month of autumn he named Xiahou Qiao and Xing Bing commissioners to inspect Jiangnan and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，京東水災，遣使安撫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinhai, the capital east circuit suffered flood; envoys were dispatched to comfort and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the eighth month floods struck eastern Shandong and he sent relief commissioners.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，雷有終大敗賊黨，復益州，殺三千餘人。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiachen, Lei Youzhong greatly defeated the bandit party, recovered Yizhou, and killed more than three thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the tenth month of winter Lei Youzhong routed the rebels, retook Yizhou, and slaughtered three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 壬子，綿、漢都巡檢、澄州刺史張思鈞削籍流封州。

translations.literal: On renzi, Mian and Han circuit inspector and Cheng prefecture prefect Zhang Sijun was struck from the rolls and exiled to Feng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Zhang Sijun, inspector of Mian-Han and prefect of Cheng, was disranked and banished to Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸元份宮視疾。

translations.literal: On yimao, he visited Prince Yuan Fen's palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he called on the ailing Prince Yuan Fen.

sentences.zh: 令諸州兼群牧。

translations.literal: Ordered each prefecture concurrently to oversee the herd offices.
translations.idiomatic: He required every prefecture to take charge of local herd administration.

sentences.zh: 己未，濱州防禦使王榮削籍流均州。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Binzhou defense commissioner Wang Rong was struck from the rolls and exiled to Jun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wang Rong, defense commissioner of Binzhou, was disranked and sent to Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，雷有終追斬王均于富順監，禽其黨六千餘人。

translations.literal: On jichou, Lei Youzhong pursued and beheaded Wang Jun at Fushun Prison and captured more than six thousand of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Lei Youzhong ran Wang Jun down at Fushun Prison, took his head, and rounded up six thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 詔原川峽路繫囚雜犯死罪以下。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned mixed offenders in Sichuan and the mountain passes below capital crime.
translations.idiomatic: He pardoned every Sichuan prisoner below capital grade implicated in the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 雷有終等以功進秩有差。

translations.literal: Lei Youzhong and others were promoted in rank according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: Lei Youzhong and his officers received graded promotions for the victory.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以翰林學士王欽若、知制誥梁顥分為川、峽安撫使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Hanlin Academician Wang Qinruo and drafting drafter Liang Hao were made Sichuan and mountain-pass pacification commissioners respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he sent Wang Qinruo and Liang Hao to pacify Sichuan and the mountain passes as paired commissioners.

sentences.zh: 延州言破大盧、小盧等十族，獲人畜二十萬。

translations.literal: Yanzhou reported defeating the great Lu and lesser Lu tribes and ten others, capturing two hundred thousand head of men and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou reported crushing the great and lesser Lu confederations and eight allied tribes, taking two hundred thousand captives and animals.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，環慶副部署徐興削籍配郢州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, Huanqing deputy deployment Xu Xing was struck from the rolls and assigned to Ying prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the eleventh month Xu Xing, deputy commander of Huanqing, was disranked and banished to Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，靈州副部署孫進責授復州團練副使。

translations.literal: On yihai, Lingzhou deputy deployment Sun Jin was demoted to Fuzhou training vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Lingzhou deputy Sun Jin was reduced to training vice commissioner at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 鄆州決河塞。

translations.literal: The breached Yellow River at Yan prefecture was sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Labor gangs finally closed the Yanzhou breach in the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，均畿內田稅。

translations.literal: On wuyin, land tax in the capital region was equalized.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he ordered a fresh equalization of land tax around the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔群臣盡言無諱，常參官轉對如故事，未預次對者聽封事以聞。

translations.literal: On renwu, an edict ordered the hundred officials to speak without reserve; regular attendees were to present rotating memorials as of old, and those not yet scheduled for rotation might submit sealed memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he invited blunt counsel from the bureaucracy, restored rotating palace memorials, and allowed sealed submissions from officials still waiting their turn.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，日南至，御朝元殿受朝。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the winter solstice; he received court at Chaoyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter solstice, xinmao, he held court at Chaoyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙申，張齊賢罷為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Zhang Qixian was dismissed and made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhang Qixian left the chief councilorship for the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，狩近郊，以親獲禽獻太廟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wushen, he hunted near the suburbs; what he took with his own hand was offered to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the twelfth month he hunted outside the walls and sent his own kill to the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大宴含光殿。

translations.literal: On jiayin, a great feast was held at Hanguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he gave a grand banquet at Hanguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸元份宮視疾。

translations.literal: On yimao, he visited Prince Yuan Fen's palace to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he again called on the sick Prince Yuan Fen.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，閱武藝，遂宴射苑中。

translations.literal: On dingsi, martial arts were reviewed, then feasting and archery in the garden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he inspected martial drill, then feasted and shot in the palace gardens.

sentences.zh: 庚申，罷京畿均田稅。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the capital-region equalized land tax was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he canceled the capital equalization of land tax.

sentences.zh: 育吾蕃部貢犛牛。

translations.literal: The Yuwu tribal department presented yak.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuwu tribes sent tribute yaks.

sentences.zh: 甲子，契丹稅木監使黃顒等率屬內附，賜冠帶。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Khitan timber-tax supervisor Huang Yong and others led their dependents to submit and were granted caps and belts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Huang Yong, the Khitan timber-tax overseer, defected with his clansmen and received court dress.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，開封府奏獄空，詔嘉之。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Kaifeng prefecture reported empty prisons; an edict praised this.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Kaifeng reported no prisoners in its jails, and the throne commended the magistrates.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔河東、北緣邊吏民斬邊寇首一級支錢五千，禽者倍之，獲馬者給帛二十匹。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict stated: for Hedong and northern frontier officials and commoners, beheading one border raider paid five thousand cash, capture paid double, and seizing a horse paid twenty bolts of cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he posted frontier bounties: five thousand cash per Khitan head, double for prisoners, twenty bolts of silk per captured horse.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、大食國、高州蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goryeo, the Dashi state, and Gaozhou barbarians came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies arrived from Goryeo, the Arab lands, and Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 畿內、江南、荊湖旱，果、閬州水，並振之。

translations.literal: The capital region, Jiangnan, and Jing-Hu suffered drought; Guo and Lang prefectures suffered flood; all were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Drought struck the capital circuits, Jiangnan, and Jing-Hu; floods hit Guo and Lang; relief grain went to every stricken district.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲戌朔，詔天下繫囚死罪己下減一等，杖罪釋之。

translations.literal: In year four, spring, the first month, on jiaxu, the new-moon day, an edict ordered that prisoners below capital crime be reduced one degree and flogging offenses released.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping year four, on the jiaxu new moon in the first month of spring, he commuted sentences below death and freed everyone punished by the rod.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸范廷召第視疾。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he visited Fan Tingzhao's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he called at the sickbed of Fan Tingzhao, the northern commander.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命樞密直學士馮拯、陳堯叟詳中外封事。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Palace Proclamation Academician Feng Zheng and Chen Yaosou were ordered to examine sealed memorials from within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he told Feng Zheng and Chen Yaosou to sift every sealed memorial arriving at court.

sentences.zh: 詔應益州軍民因城亂殺傷劫盜，除官吏外皆釋不問。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned Yizhou soldiers and civilians who in the course of the rebellion had killed, wounded, robbed, or plundered, excepting officials, all without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: He declared a blanket pardon for every Yizhou soldier or civilian guilty of riot murder or looting, sparing only the rebel officers.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命收瘞西川遺骸。

translations.literal: Ordered that scattered bones in western Sichuan be gathered and buried.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the burial teams to gather and inter the bones littering western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸開寶寺，還御乾天門觀燈。

translations.literal: On dinghai, he visited Kaibao Temple, then returned to view lanterns at Qiantian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he worshipped at Kaibao Temple and ended the night watching lantern displays at Qiantian Gate.

sentences.zh: 庚子，謁啟聖院太宗神御殿。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he visited Qisheng Abbey's spirit hall of Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he paid homage at Taizong's spirit hall in Qisheng Abbey.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，祈雨。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingwei, prayers were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the second month he ordered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊申，交州黎桓貢馴犀象。

translations.literal: On wushen, Jiaozhou's Li Huan presented tame rhinoceroses and elephants.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Huan of Jiaozhou sent tame rhinoceroses and elephants as tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，決天下獄。

translations.literal: On guichou, prisons throughout the empire were adjudicated.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he held a general prison review across the empire.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸大相國寺、上清宮祈雨。

translations.literal: On dingsi, he visited the Grand Xiangguo Temple and Shangqing Palace to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he prayed for rain at the Grand Xiangguo and Shangqing abbeys.

sentences.zh: 戊午，雨，帝方臨軒決事，霑服不御蓋。

translations.literal: On wuwu, rain fell; the Emperor was just holding court to decide affairs, his robes soaked and he would not use a canopy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the rains came while he sat in open court; his robes were drenched and he refused an umbrella.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔群臣子弟奏補京官者試一經。

translations.literal: On renxu, an edict ordered that sons of officials and ministers seeking appointment as capital officials be examined in one classic.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he required the sons of high officials to pass a classics examination before entering capital service.

sentences.zh: 甲子，釋逋負官物者二千六百餘人，蠲逋負物二百六十餘萬；

translations.literal: On jiazi, more than twenty-six hundred persons owing government goods in arrears were released, and more than 2.6 million in arrears remitted;
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he freed twenty-six hundred debtors to the state treasury and canceled 2.6 million in back payments;

sentences.zh: 已納而非理者以內府錢還之，沒者給其家。

translations.literal: those who had paid unjustly were repaid from the inner treasury, and the families of those who had been confiscated from were compensated.
translations.idiomatic: repaid anyone who had been squeezed unjustly from the palace treasury and compensated families ruined by wrongful seizure.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔學士、兩省御史臺五品、尚書省諸司四品以上，舉賢良方正直言敢諫一人。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict ordered academicians, Secretariat and Chancellery censors of the fifth rank, and various offices of the fourth rank and above in the Ministries to recommend one man of worth, integrity, and upright speech fit to remonstrate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he told senior scholars, censors, and fourth-rank ministry officers each to nominate one candidate for the "worthies and remonstrators" examination.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置永利監。

translations.literal: On jisi, Yongli Directorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he established the Yongli salt directorate.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，撫水州蠻酋蒙瑛等來納兵器、毒藥箭，誓不復犯邊。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiaxu, Fushui prefecture Man chief Meng Ying and others came to surrender weapons and poisoned arrows, swearing never again to raid the border.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Meng Ying of Fushui surrendered his arms and poisoned arrows, swearing never again to raid the frontier.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔史館韓瑗等舉御史臺推勘官。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict ordered the History Institute's Han Yuan and others to recommend censorate investigating officers.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he told Han Yuan at the History Institute to nominate censorate investigators.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，風雪，帝謂宰相曰：「霾曀頗甚，卿等思闕政，以佐予治。

translations.literal: On dingchou, wind and snow fell; the Emperor told the chief councilors: "The haze is quite thick; you should consider where government falls short and aid me in governing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, in wind and snow, he told Li Hao and his colleagues: "The sky is foul—find the flaws in my rule and help me mend them.

sentences.zh: 」李沆等乞免官，不許。

translations.literal: " Li Hao and others begged to be dismissed from office; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hao and the others begged to resign; he would not hear of it.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，分川峽轉運使為益、利、梓、夔四路。
