translations.literal: On xinsi, the Sichuan circuit transport commissioner was divided into Yi, Li, Zi, and Kui four routes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he split Sichuan transport into four circuits: Yi, Li, Zi, and Kui.

sentences.zh: 召終南隱士种放，辭疾不至。

translations.literal: The Zhongnan hermit Zhong Fang was summoned; he declined on grounds of illness and did not come.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned the Zhongnan recluse Zhong Fang, who pleaded illness and stayed home.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，左僕射呂蒙正、兵部侍郎向敏中並平章事，中書侍郎、平章事李沆加門下侍郎；

translations.literal: On gengyin, Left Vice Director Lü Mengzheng and War Vice Minister Xiang Minzhong were both made chief councilors; Secretariat Vice Director and Chief Councilor Li Hao was made concurrent gate director;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Lü Mengzheng and Xiang Minzhong joined the chief council, and Li Hao added the title of gate director;

sentences.zh: 高瓊為殿前都指揮使，葛霸為侍衛馬軍都指揮使，王漢忠為殿前副都指揮使，並領節度。

translations.literal: Gao Qiong was made overall commander of the Palace Front; Ge Ba commander of the Palace Cavalry; Wang Hanzhong deputy overall commander of the Palace Front; all held concurrent military governorships.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qiong took the Palace Front, Ge Ba the cavalry, and Wang Hanzhong the deputy front command, each with a concurrent frontier commission.

sentences.zh: 司天監進儀天曆。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy presented the Yitian calendar.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy submitted the revised Yitian calendar.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以參知政事王化基為工部尚書，同知樞密院事王旦為工部侍郎、參知政事，樞密直學士馮拯、陳堯叟並為右諫議大夫、同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Associate Chief Councilor Wang Huaji was made Minister of Works; Associate Military Affairs Director Wang Dan was made Vice Minister of Works and associate chief councilor; Military Affairs Academicians Feng Zheng and Chen Yaosou were both made right remonstrance grand masters and associate military affairs directors.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Wang Huaji moved to the Ministry of Works, Wang Dan rose to associate chief councilor, and Feng Zheng and Chen Yaosou became associate military affairs directors.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，葛霸為并代行營都部署。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingwu, Ge Ba was made overall commander of the Bing and Dai field army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fourth month of summer Ge Ba took command of the Bing-Dai expedition.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔親老無兼侍者特與近任。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict ordered that those whose parents were old and had no one else to serve them be specially given a nearby post.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he ordered that officials with aged parents and no other sons at home receive appointments near the capital.

sentences.zh: 回鶻可汗祿勝貢玉勒鞍、名馬、寶器，願以兵助討繼遷。

translations.literal: The Uighur qaghan Lu Sheng presented jade saddles, famous horses, and precious vessels, and wished to send troops to help attack Jiqian.
translations.idiomatic: The Uighur qaghan Lu Sheng sent jade saddles, fine horses, and treasure, offering troops against Li Jiqian.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，審官院引對京朝官，閱殿最而黜陟之。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Bureau of Appointments presented capital officials for audience, reviewed their performance ratings, and promoted or demoted them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the Bureau of Appointments paraded capital officials before the throne and graded them for promotion or demotion.

sentences.zh: 己未，以王欽若為左諫議大夫、參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Wang Qinruo was made left remonstrance grand master and associate chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wang Qinruo entered the council as left remonstrance grand master.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸元份宮視疾，遂幸諸王宮。

translations.literal: On gengshen, he visited Prince Yuan Fen's palace to inquire after his illness, then visited the palaces of the other princes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he called on the sick Prince Yuan Fen and then made the rounds of his brothers' palaces.

sentences.zh: 辛未，御試制科舉人。

translations.literal: On xinwei, he personally examined special-decree examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he held the special "worthies and remonstrators" examination in person.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申朔，御乾元殿受朝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renshen, the new-moon day, he received court at Qianyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen new moon in the fifth month he held court at Qianyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 京畿繫囚罪流以下遞減一等，杖罪釋之。

translations.literal: Capital-region prisoners with sentences of exile and below were reduced one degree in succession, and flogging offenses released.
translations.idiomatic: He commuted capital prisoners below exile one degree and freed those punished by the rod.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以元儼為平海軍節度使。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Yuan Yan was made Pinghai Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Prince Yuan Yan received the Pinghai Army commission.

sentences.zh: 甲申，工部侍郎致仕朱昂對便殿，賜器幣。

translations.literal: On jiashen, retired Vice Minister of Works Zhu Ang was received in the side hall and granted vessels and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the retired scholar Zhu Ang was received in the side hall and given gifts.

sentences.zh: 戊子，亳州貢白兔，還之。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Bozhou presented a white hare; it was returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Bozhou sent up a white hare; the court sent it back.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大同軍留後桑贊為侍衛步軍副都指揮使，領河西軍節度。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Datong Army acting military governor Sang Zan was made deputy overall commander of the Palace Infantry and given concurrent Hexi Army military governorship.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Sang Zan of Datong became deputy infantry commander with the Hexi Army commission.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，有司言減天下冗吏凡十九萬五千餘人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guimao, the relevant office reported reducing superfluous clerks throughout the empire by 195,000-odd persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guimao, the ministries reported cutting 195,000 redundant clerks empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔東川民田先為江水所害者除其租。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict ordered that for eastern Sichuan farmland earlier damaged by river water, the rent be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he canceled rent on eastern Sichuan fields ruined by the rivers.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔州縣學校及聚徒講誦之所，並賜九經。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict ordered that prefectural and county schools and places where students gathered to lecture be granted the Nine Classics.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he ordered a full set of the Nine Classics sent to every prefectural school and public lecture hall.

sentences.zh: 戊申，出陣圖示宰相，命督將練士，以備北邊。

translations.literal: On wushen, battle formations were shown to the chief councilors, who were ordered to supervise generals in drilling troops to prepare the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he showed his chancellors the frontier battle maps and told them to drill the northern armies.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，以河朔饋運勞民，詔轉運使減徭役存恤。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengwu, because supplying the Hebei front overburdened the people, an edict ordered transport commissioners to reduce corvée and preserve and comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the seventh month of autumn, citing the strain of Hebei supply lines, he told transport commissioners to cut corvée and ease local burdens.

sentences.zh: 己卯，邊臣言契丹謀入寇。

translations.literal: On jimao, frontier officials reported that the Khitan planned to invade.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the frontier warned that the Khitan were massing for invasion.

sentences.zh: 以王顯為鎮、定、高陽關三路都部署，王超為副都部署，王漢忠為都排陣使。

translations.literal: Wang Xian was made overall commander of the Zhen, Ding, and Gaoyang Pass three routes; Wang Chao was made deputy overall commander; Wang Hanzhong was made chief battle array officer.
translations.idiomatic: He named Wang Xian supreme commander of Zhen, Ding, and Gaoyang Pass, with Wang Chao as deputy and Wang Hanzhong as chief battle officer.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，張齊賢為涇、原等州安撫經略使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinchou, Zhang Qixian was made Jing and Yuan and other prefectures pacification and defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the eighth month Zhang Qixian took pacification command on the Jing-Yuan frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊申，出環慶至靈州地圖險要示宰相，議戰守方略。

translations.literal: On wushen, maps of terrain and strategic points from Huanqing to Lingzhou were produced for the chief councilors, and battle and defense plans were discussed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he laid before the council maps of the Huanqing-Lingzhou corridor and debated how to hold or strike.

sentences.zh: 己酉，御試制科舉人。

translations.literal: On jiyou, he personally examined special-decree examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he again examined the special-decree graduates in person.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸開寶寺。

translations.literal: On renzi, he visited Kaibao Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he worshipped at Kaibao Temple.

sentences.zh: 又幸御龍營閱武藝，賜緡錢有差。

translations.literal: Again he visited the Imperial Dragon Camp to review martial arts and bestowed cash in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: He then inspected drill at the Imperial Dragon Camp and paid the troops bonuses by rank.

sentences.zh: 遂觀稼北郊，宴射於含芳園。

translations.literal: He then viewed the harvest in the northern suburbs and feasted and shot at Hanfang Garden.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he rode north to inspect the crops and feasted and shot at Hanfang Garden.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣使巴蜀，廉察風俗、官吏能否。

translations.literal: On dingmao, envoys were dispatched to Ba and Shu to investigate customs and whether officials were capable.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he sent commissioners through Ba-Shu to audit local customs and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，社宴宰相於中書。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the community sacrifice feast for the chief councilors was held at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he hosted the autumn sacrifice feast for his chancellors at the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九月，慶州地震。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Qing prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an earthquake struck Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 李繼遷陷清遠軍。

translations.literal: Li Jiqian captured Qingyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiqian took Qingyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，曹璨以蕃兵邀李繼遷輜重於唐龍鎮。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Cao Can with tribal troops intercepted Li Jiqian's baggage train at Tanglong post.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Cao Can ambushed Li Jiqian's supply column at Tanglong with tribal auxiliaries.

sentences.zh: 己未，張斌破契丹于長城口。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Zhang Bin defeated the Khitan at Changcheng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Zhang Bin routed the Khitan at Changcheng Pass.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，知階州竇玭獻白鷹，還之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renshen, Jie prefecture prefect Dou Pin presented a white hawk; it was returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Dou Pin of Jiezhou sent up a white hawk; the court returned it.

sentences.zh: 王顯奏破契丹，戮二萬人，獲統軍鐵林等。

translations.literal: Wang Xian memorialized defeating the Khitan, slaughtering twenty thousand men, and capturing commander-in-chief Tielin and others.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xian reported a great victory over the Khitan—twenty thousand killed and commander Tielin taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，京城民獲金牌，有「趙為君萬年」字。

translations.literal: On guawei, capital commoners obtained a gold plaque inscribed "Zhao as ruler for ten thousand years."
translations.idiomatic: On guawei townspeople dug up a gold tablet reading "Zhao shall rule ten thousand years."

sentences.zh: 庚寅，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On gengyin, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he hunted outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 甲午，龜茲國來貢。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Kucha state came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Kucha sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，詔：蜀賊王均既平，除追捕亡命，餘詿誤之民並釋不問。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingwei, an edict stated: since the Sichuan bandit Wang Jun has been pacified, except for pursuing fugitives, all people implicated by mistake are pardoned without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he pardoned every Sichuaner still entangled in Wang Jun's rebellion except active fugitives.

sentences.zh: 訛言動眾者，有司斬以聞。

translations.literal: Those whose false words stirred the multitude— the relevant office was to behead them and report.
translations.idiomatic: Rumor-mongers were to be executed on the spot and reported to court.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太白晝見南斗。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Great White Star was seen in daylight in the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Venus appeared by day within the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔罷三路都部署兼河北轉運使。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict ordered abolishing the three-route overall commanderships' concurrent posts as Hebei transport commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he stripped the northern commanders of their concurrent Hebei transport duties.

sentences.zh: 閏月己巳，幸大相國寺。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jisi, he visited the Grand Xiangguo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jisi, he worshipped at the Grand Xiangguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，邠寧副都部署楊瓊等七將流嶺南。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Binning deputy overall deployment Yang Qiong and six other generals were exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Yang Qiong, deputy commander of Binning, and six fellow generals were banished to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，李繼遷蕃族訛遇等歸順。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Li Jiqian's tribal follower Eyu and others submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Eyu and other Tangut clans under Li Jiqian defected.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以兵部尚書張齊賢為右僕射。

translations.literal: On jimao, War Minister Zhang Qixian was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Zhang Qixian rose from the Ministry of War to right vice director.

sentences.zh: 壬午，靈州言河外砦主李瓊等以城降西夏。

translations.literal: On renwu, Lingzhou reported that fort commanders Li Qiong and others beyond the river surrendered their posts to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Lingzhou reported that Li Qiong and other outpost commanders beyond the river had yielded to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 上念其力屈就禽，特釋其親屬。

translations.literal: The Emperor, mindful that they had exhausted their strength before being captured, specially released their kin.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful that they had fought until broken, he spared their families punishment.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，李繼遷部族訛豬等率屬來附。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Li Jiqian's tribal follower Ezhu and others led their dependents to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Ezhu and other Li Jiqian clansmen came in with their households.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，河北饑，蠲賦減役，發廩振之。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Hebei suffered famine; taxes and corvée were remitted, granaries opened, and relief distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin famine struck Hebei; he cut taxes and corvée and opened the granaries.

sentences.zh: 是歲，龜茲、丹眉流、宜高上溪撫水州蠻來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Kucha, Danmeiliu, Yigao, Shangxipu, and Fushui prefecture Man came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute arrived from Kucha, Danmeiliu, Yigao, Shangxipu, and the Fushui tribes.

sentences.zh: 梓州水，遣使振恤。

translations.literal: Zi prefecture suffered flood; envoys were dispatched to comfort and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: Floods hit Zizhou and he sent relief commissioners.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬寅，李繼遷部將臥浪己等內附，給田宅。

translations.literal: In year five, spring, the first month, on renyin, Li Jiqian's subordinate Wolangji and others came to submit and were given farmland and houses.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping year five, on renyin in the first month of spring, Wolangji and other Li Jiqian officers defected and received farms and houses.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，環慶部署張凝襲諸蕃，焚族帳二百餘，斬首五千級，降九百餘人。

translations.literal: On renxu, Huanqing deployment Zhang Ning raided the various tribes, burning more than two hundred clan tents, beheading five thousand heads, and accepting the surrender of more than nine hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhang Ning of Huanqing burned two hundred tribal tents, took five thousand heads, and accepted nine hundred surrenders.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，詔邊士疾病戰沒者，冬春衣聽給其家。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yiyou, an edict ordered that for frontier soldiers who fell ill or died in battle, winter clothing might be issued to their families.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the second month he ordered winter clothing issued to families of frontier soldiers who fell sick or died in service.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸上清宮。

translations.literal: On jichou, he visited Shangqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he worshipped at Shangqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 以王漢忠為邠寧、環慶路都部署。

translations.literal: Wang Hanzhong was made overall commander of the Binning and Huanqing routes.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hanzhong received overall command of Binning and Huanqing.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，李繼遷陷靈州，知州裴濟死之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingyou, Li Jiqian captured Lingzhou; Prefect Pei Ji died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the third month Li Jiqian stormed Lingzhou and Prefect Pei Ji fell with the city.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，比部員外郎洪湛削籍流儋州，工部尚書趙昌言責授安遠軍司馬，知雜御史范正辭滁州團練副使。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Ministry of Revenue outer-office official Hong Zhan was struck from the rolls and exiled to Dan prefecture; Works Minister Zhao Changyan was demoted to Anyuan Army aide; supervising miscellaneous censor Fan Zhengci was made Chuzhou training vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Hong Zhan was disranked and sent to Danzhou, Zhao Changyan demoted to aide at Anyuan Army, and Fan Zhengci reduced to training vice commissioner at Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，御試禮部舉人。

translations.literal: On jiwei, he personally examined Ministry of Rites examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he held the civil examination in person.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，詔陝西民輓送緣邊芻糧者，賜租之半。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on renshen, an edict ordered that for Shaanxi commoners who carted fodder and grain to the frontier, half the rent be bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the fourth month of summer he halved the land tax for Shaanxi farmers hauling frontier grain.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命三司歲較戶口。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Three Departments were ordered annually to compare household registers.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he ordered the fiscal offices to reconcile household registers every year.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜深、霸九州民租有差。

translations.literal: On bingxu, rent for the people of Shen and Ba prefectures was bestowed in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he granted graded rent relief in Shen and Ba prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復雄州榷場。

translations.literal: On guisi, the Xiongzhou border market was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he reopened the border market at Xiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，減河北冗官。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengzi, superfluous Hebei officials were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengzi, he cut redundant Hebei posts.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，知榮州褚德臻坐盜取官銀，棄市。

translations.literal: On renyin, Rong prefecture prefect Chu Dezhen, for stealing official silver, was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Chu Dezhen, prefect of Rongzhou, was beheaded in public for embezzling government silver.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，置憲州。

translations.literal: On guimao, Xian prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he established Xian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 代州進士李光輔善擊劍，詣闕。

translations.literal: A Daizhou advanced scholar, Li Guangfu, was skilled at swordplay and came to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangfu, a Daizhou examination candidate famed for swordsmanship, presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「若獎用之，民悉好劍矣。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "If I reward and employ him, the people will all take to swords.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong said: "Reward him and every farmer will abandon the plow for the blade.

sentences.zh: 」遣還。

translations.literal: " He was sent back.
translations.idiomatic: He sent the swordsman home.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔申明內侍養一子制。

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict clarified the regulation on palace eunuchs raising one son.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he reissued the rule allowing each palace eunuch one adopted heir.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，蠲天下逋負。

translations.literal: On yisi, arrears throughout the empire were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he canceled tax and levy arrears empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以王顯為河陽三城節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Wang Xian was made Heyang Three Cities military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Wang Xian left the northern command for the Heyang Three Cities commission.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，繼遷圍麟州，曹璨請濟師，詔發并、代、石、隰州兵援之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guiyou, Jiqian besieged Lin prefecture; Cao Can requested reinforcements, and an edict ordered troops from Bing, Dai, Shi, and Xi prefectures sent to aid.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Jiqian besieged Linzhou; Cao Can begged for help, and the court rushed troops from Bing, Dai, Shi, and Xi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以侍衛馬軍都虞候王超為定州路駐泊行營都部署。

translations.literal: On yihai, Palace Cavalry company commander Wang Chao was made overall commander of the Dingzhou route garrison field army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wang Chao took the Dingzhou garrison command.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以宣徽南院使、知樞密院事周瑩為永清軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao, south-court palace proclamation commissioner and military affairs director Zhou Ying was made Yongqing Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Zhou Ying traded his military affairs post for the Yongqing Army commission.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔益兵八千分屯環慶、涇原。

translations.literal: On jiyou, an edict ordered eight thousand additional troops stationed in divided garrisons at Huanqing and Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he reinforced Huanqing and Jingyuan with eight thousand new troops.

sentences.zh: 知麟州衛居實言繼遷以眾二萬來攻，城兵出擊走之，殺傷過半。

translations.literal: Lin prefecture prefect Wei Jushi reported that Jiqian came to attack with twenty thousand men; the city troops sallied, routed them, and killed and wounded more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wei Jushi of Linzhou reported beating off a twenty-thousand-man assault by Li Jiqian with half the enemy killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 是月，都城大雨，壞廬舍，民有壓死者，振恤其家。

translations.literal: That month, the capital suffered great rain that destroyed houses; commoners were crushed to death; their families were comforted and relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month cloudbursts wrecked houses in the capital and killed civilians; he ordered relief for every bereaved family.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiawu, the new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon in the seventh month of autumn the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸啟聖院、太平興國寺、上清宮致禱，雨霽，遂幸龍衛營視所壞垣室，勞賜有差。

translations.literal: On wuxu, he visited Qisheng Abbey, Taiping Xingguo Temple, and Shangqing Palace to offer prayers; rain cleared, then he visited Dragon Guard Camp to view damaged walls and rooms and bestowed consolation gifts in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he prayed at Qisheng Abbey, Taiping Xingguo Temple, and Shangqing Palace until the skies broke; then he inspected storm damage at Dragon Guard Camp and paid the garrison bonuses.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，召終南隱士种放。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Zhongnan hermit Zhong Fang was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he summoned the Zhongnan recluse Zhong Fang again.

sentences.zh: 疏丁岡河。

translations.literal: The Dinggang River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Labor gangs dredged the Dinggang River.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔許高州蠻田彥伊子承寶等入朝，賜器帛、冠帶。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict permitted Gaozhou Man chief Tian Yan'yi's son Chengbao and others to enter court and bestowed vessels, silks, caps, and belts.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he invited Chengbao, son of the Gaozhou Man chief Tian Yan'yi, to court and dressed him with gifts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，募河北丁壯。

translations.literal: On yimao, sturdy men of Hebei were recruited.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he began recruiting able-bodied Hebei men for the frontier.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，契丹大林砦使王昭敏等來降。

translations.literal: On renxu, Khitan Dalin Fort envoy Wang Zhaomin and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wang Zhaomin and other envoys from the Khitan Dalin Fort defected.

sentences.zh: 戎人寇洪德砦，守將擊走之。

translations.literal: Rong tribesmen raided Hongde Fort; the defending commander drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal raiders struck Hongde Fort and were beaten back by the garrison.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，增川峽官奉錢。

translations.literal: On guihai, official salary cash in Sichuan and the mountain passes was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he raised salary payments for officials in Sichuan and the passes.

sentences.zh: 八月，群臣三表上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the hundred officials thrice submitted tables requesting an honorific title; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the bureaucracy three times begged him to accept a grand honorific; he refused each time.

sentences.zh: 丙子，沙州曹宗壽遣使入貢，以宗壽為歸義軍節度使。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Shazhou's Cao Zongshou dispatched envoys bearing tribute; Zongshou was made Guiyi Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Cao Zongshou of Shazhou sent tribute and received the Guiyi Army commission.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，石隰部署言河西蕃族拽浪南山等四百人來歸。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the Shi and Xi deployment reported that more than four hundred Hexi tribal followers including Zhualang Nanshan had come to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Shi-Xi command reported four hundred Hexi tribesmen led by Zhualang Nanshan coming over.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，种放對于便殿，授左司諫、直昭文館。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wushen, Zhong Fang was received in the side hall and made Left Remonstrance Office drafter and Academician of the Zhaowen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the ninth month Zhong Fang met the emperor in the side hall and received remonstrance drafter and Zhaowen academician posts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜种放第宅。

translations.literal: On yimao, a residence was bestowed on Zhong Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the court gave Zhong Fang a mansion in the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳，遣使齎藥賜鎮戎軍將士。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jisi, envoys were dispatched bearing medicine for the Zhenrong Army soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the tenth month of winter he sent palace physicians with medicine to the Zhenrong garrison.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔河西戎人歸順者，給內地閒田處之。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict ordered that for Hexi tribesmen who submitted, idle land in the interior be granted for settlement.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he promised interior farmland to every Hexi tribesman who came in.

sentences.zh: 又詔諸州長吏與佐職官同錄問大辟罪人。

translations.literal: Again an edict ordered that in each prefecture the chief administrator together with assisting officials jointly record and question those guilty of capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: He also required every prefect to join his deputies in reviewing capital cases before sentencing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，涇原部署繫內屬蕃族數叛者九十一人，請誅之，詔釋其罪。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Jingyuan deployment bound ninety-one affiliated tribesmen who had repeatedly rebelled and requested execution; an edict pardoned their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Jingyuan asked to execute ninety-one affiliated tribesmen who had rebelled again; the throne pardoned them instead.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，平章事向敏中罷為戶部侍郎，右僕射張齊賢為太常卿。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Chief Councilor Xiang Minzhong was dismissed and made Vice Minister of Revenue; Right Vice Director Zhang Qixian was made Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Xiang Minzhong left the council for the Ministry of Revenue and Zhang Qixian became chamberlain for the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，修豐州城。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Feng prefecture's walls were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin work crews restored the walls of Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，詔麟州給復一年。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen, an edict granted Lin prefecture one year's rent remission.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the eleventh month he remitted a full year of Linzhou rent.

sentences.zh: 甲午，六谷首領潘羅支等貢馬，第給其直。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Liugu tribal chieftain Pan Luozhi and others presented horses; graded payment was given at standard rates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Pan Luozhi of the Liugu tribes sent horses and received fair market payment.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，享太廟。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，祀天地于圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: On renyin, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Round Altar; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Altar and proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丁未，白州民黃受百餘歲，賜粟帛。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Baizhou commoner Huang Shou, more than one hundred years old, was granted grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Huang Shou of Baizhou, aged over a century, received grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 己酉，封子玄祐為信國公。

translations.literal: On jiyou, his son Xuanyou was enfeoffed as Duke of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou his son Xuanyou was enfeoffed as Duke of Xin.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，呂蒙正加司空，李沆加右僕射，楚王元佐為右羽林軍上將軍，雍王元份守太傅，兗王元傑守太保，曹國公元儼同平章事。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Lü Mengzheng was made Minister of Works; Li Hao was made Right Vice Director; Prince of Chu Yuan Zuo was made General-in-Chief of the Right Feathered Forest; Prince of Yong Yuan Fen remained Grand Tutor; Prince of Yan Yuan Jie remained Grand Protector; Duke of Cao Yuan Yan was made associate chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Lü Mengzheng became minister of works, Li Hao right vice director, Prince Yuan Zuo general of the right feathered forest, Yuan Fen grand tutor, Yuan Jie grand protector, and Prince Yuan Yan joined the council.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，賜京城百歲老人祝道嵓爵一級。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renwu, the capital centenarian Zhudao Yan was granted one step in noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the twelfth month the capital centenarian Zhudao Yan received a promotion in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遷麟州內屬人於樓煩。

translations.literal: On guiwei, affiliated people of Lin prefecture were moved to settle at Loufan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei tribesmen attached to Linzhou were resettled at Loufan.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河北、鄭、曹、滑州饑，振之。

translations.literal: That year, Hebei and Zheng, Cao, and Hua prefectures suffered famine; relief was distributed.
translations.idiomatic: That year famine struck Hebei and Zheng, Cao, and Huazhou; the court opened the granaries.
